properties.statement: An emitted distinct set contains exactly the keys in the input.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (key : α) (keys : List α), key ∈ Esm.Determinism.distinct keys ↔ key ∈ keys

properties.statement: The distinct output is strictly ascending under the key order.
Permuting the input does not change the emitted distinct set or its order.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (a b : List α), a.Perm b → Esm.Determinism.distinct a = Esm.Determinism.distinct b

properties.statement: Emitting the distinct set a second time gives the same ordered keys.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (keys : List α), Esm.Determinism.distinct (Esm.Determinism.distinct keys) = Esm.Determinism.distinct keys

properties.statement: Reversing the endpoints of an undirected relation leaves its canonical tuple unchanged.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (a b : α), Esm.Determinism.edgeEndpoints a b = Esm.Determinism.edgeEndpoints b a

properties.statement: The zero-based rank of an emitted distinct key is a bijection to the positions of the output list.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (keys : List α), Function.Bijective (Esm.Determinism.denseRank (Esm.Determinism.distinct keys))

properties.statement: The zero-based rank of a distinct key equals the number of distinct keys strictly smaller than it.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (keys : List α) (key : { k // k ∈ Esm.Determinism.distinct keys }), (Esm.Determinism.denseRank (Esm.Determinism.distinct keys) key).val = ((Esm.Determinism.distinct keys).filter (fun value => decide (value < key.val))).length

properties.statement: A key and pair of positions occur in the equality match set exactly when both positioned input rows have that key.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (left right : List (α × Int)) (key : α) (i j : Int), toLex (key, toLex (i, j)) ∈ Esm.Determinism.equalityMatches left right ↔ (key, i) ∈ left ∧ (key, j) ∈ right

properties.statement: The equality match set is ordered lexicographically by key, left position, and right position.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (left right : List (α × Int)), (Esm.Determinism.equalityMatches left right).Pairwise (· < ·)

properties.statement: Permuting either input's position-tagged rows does not change the equality match set.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (a b c d : List (α × Int)), a.Perm b → c.Perm d → Esm.Determinism.equalityMatches a c = Esm.Determinism.equalityMatches b d

properties.statement: The keys of an exact additive group-by are strictly ascending.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α β : Type} [LinearOrder α] [AddCommMonoid β] (rows : List (α × β)), ((Esm.Determinism.groupBySum rows).map Prod.fst).Pairwise (· < ·)

properties.statement: A group-by emits each observed key with the sum of precisely those input values whose rows have that key.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α β : Type} [LinearOrder α] [AddCommMonoid β] (rows : List (α × β)) (key : α) (value : β), (key, value) ∈ Esm.Determinism.groupBySum rows ↔ key ∈ rows.map Prod.fst ∧ value = ((rows.filter fun row => row.1 = key).map Prod.snd).sum

properties.statement: Permuting group-by input rows leaves ordered keys and their exact sums unchanged.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α β : Type} [LinearOrder α] [AddCommMonoid β] (a b : List (α × β)), a.Perm b → Esm.Determinism.groupBySum a = Esm.Determinism.groupBySum b
